agent judge on eligibility.discount_tiers: Quote gives 90% for >150% to 175% FPL, but the 25% tier's 175-400% bounds are not stated; the 25% is only tied to Medically Indigent status, with no 400% bound.

agent judge on eligibility.assistance_ceiling_fpl: Quote says income must be at or below 400% FPL plus a medical-expense test. It is a qualifying condition, not a statement that no assistance is offered above 400%.
agent judge on eligibility.residency: Quote is a mission statement about serving everyone in the service area; it says nothing about residency requirements.

agent judge on eligibility.insured_patients_covered: Quote only says CDPH decides whether underinsured patients may get help with deductibles, co-insurance, or co-payments; it does not state insured patients are covered.
